name: s3Write
syntax: s3Write(bucket, object, value [, charset, mimeType, acl, location, accessKeyId, secretKey, host])
description: Writes a value (string, binary or scalar) to an object in an S3 (or S3-compatible) bucket. The MIME type is auto-detected from the object key extension when not supplied explicitly.

params.name: bucket
params.description: The name of the S3 bucket to write to.

params.name: value
params.description: The data to write: a string (encoded as bytes), a binary value, or a scalar (stringified).

params.name: charset
params.description: Character encoding used when encoding string data (defaults to UTF-8).

params.name: mimeType
params.description: Content-Type header for the object. When omitted, it is guessed from the object key extension.

params.name: acl
params.description: Object ACL to apply (accepted for compatibility; not enforced).

params.name: accessKeyId
params.description: Inline AWS access key id. Overrides credentials from Application.cfc and environment variables.

params.name: host
params.description: Inline endpoint URL for S3-compatible providers (e.g. Cloudflare R2, MinIO).

examples.title: Write a string to a bucket
examples.description: Stores a text value under the given key.
